reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: function is exported in a 'use server' file — Next.js HTTP POST endpoint, public API exception applies regardless of zero internal callers. Gate 2: no trust_assumptions defined in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json, gate cannot trigger. Gate 3: src/lib/actions/ is explicitly in scope. An attacker can trigger this via the updateMemberTeams server action endpoint by POSTing with a soft-deleted member's supabase_auth_user_id and desired teamIds as an authenticated admin, causing team relations to be inserted for a logically deleted member and Discord role sync to fire, violating the deleted_at pre-condition specified in the property.
